title: iqm.cpc.core.observation.observation_handler.load_observations_by_rules
description:
Load observations resolved by the given rules, keyed by whichever dut fields they resolve to. Unlike populating an ObservationHandler with every known dut field, this only touches the dut
fields that ...
content:
Load observations resolved by the given rules, keyed by whichever dut fields they resolve to. Unlike populating an ObservationHandler with every known dut field, this only touches the dut
fields that the given load_rules themselves surface from the DB, so it works without any prior
knowledge of which dut fields exist for the DUT. As a consequence, a rule that isn’t a CacheableLoadRule (e.g. Fail , LatestFromStash ) never contributes any dut
field to resolve against, since there’s no cached query result to discover them from. title: iqm.cpc.compiler.dd.apply_dd_strategy
description:
Insert dynamical decoupling sequences into the schedules iff dd_is_disabled is False. By default DD is controlled by a DDStrategy , which can be provided in context["DDStrategy"] ,
or as individual fi...
content:
Insert dynamical decoupling sequences into the schedules iff dd_is_disabled is False. By default DD is controlled by a DDStrategy , which can be provided in context["DDStrategy"] ,
or as individual fields in the settings tree (the DDStrategy_* parameters).
Alternatively you can override this with qubit-specific DD strategies, or idling window -specific DD strategies.
The precedence of the parameters to this function (highest first) is idling_specific_dd — per-idle-window DD. May be either an IdleDDMap mapping IdleWindowKey keys to DDGateSequence lists
(the longest sequence that fits in the idle window is applied) or to None (no DD for this window). a callable IdleDDMapBuilder .
Invoked inside the pass after waits are merged and idle windows
enumerated, but before any DD pulse is applied. Idle windows not in the map use the default DD sequence defined in DDStrategy , if any. To inspect the idle windows before choosing an idling_specific_dd map, see the workflow in iqm.cpc.compiler.dd . qubit_specific_dd — per-qubit DD.
Maps qubit name to the DD sequence applied on that qubit, or None (no DD for this qubit).
Qubits not in the map use the default DD strategy, if any. context["DDStrategy"] , describing the global default DD strategy. DDStrategy built from the individual DDStrategy_* parameters. These are initialized
to STANDARD_DD_STRATEGY in the settings tree, so the standard strategy is the default
unless you change them. Note qubit_specific_dd and idling_specific_dd are compile-only settings: their values
cannot be serialized (e.g. callables and dicts), so this pass removes them
from context["settings"] when it finishes. schedules ( list [ Schedule ] ) – Schedules representing the compiled circuits. builder ( ScheduleBuilder ) – The ScheduleBuilder. context ( dict [ str , Any ] ) – Compiler context. dd_is_disabled ( bool ) – Set to False to enable dynamical decoupling. qubit_specific_dd ( dict [ str , list [ DDGateSequence ] | None ] | None ) – Per-qubit DD map. Maps physical qubit name to the DD sequences applied to idle windows
on that qubit, or None to mean no DD sequence is applied on that qubit. Qubits not in the map
use the default DD strategy. idling_specific_dd ( dict [ IdleWindowKey , list [ DDGateSequence ] | None ] | IdleDDMapBuilder | None ) – Per-idle-window DD. Either an IdleDDMap (dict from IdleWindowKey to a gate_sequences list or None ),
or an IdleDDMapBuilder callable fn(idle_windows, schedules, builder) -> IdleDDMap | None (useful for
automated decisions — see the module docstring of iqm.cpc.compiler.dd ). DDStrategy_merge_contiguous_waits ( bool ) – Whether to merge contiguous waits (see DDStrategy ). DDStrategy_target_qubits ( list [ str ] | None ) – The qubits to which DD is applied ( None means apply to every applicable qubit). DDStrategy_skip_leading_wait ( bool ) – Whether to skip leading waits (see DDStrategy ). DDStrategy_skip_trailing_wait ( bool ) – Whether to skip trailing waits (see DDStrategy ). DDStrategy_gate_sequences_ratio ( list [ int ] ) – Minimal durations for the Wait to be replaced with the DD sequence
(in PRX gate durations) in the DD sequence. Defaults to the ratios of STANDARD_DD_STRATEGY . DDStrategy_gate_sequences_gate_pattern_xy ( list [ str ] ) – XY Gate patterns in the DD sequence. If you want to provide custom
PRX angles instead of XY patterns, you must provide the DDStrategy in the Compiler context.
Defaults to the gate patterns of STANDARD_DD_STRATEGY . DDStrategy_gate_sequences_align ( list [ str ] ) – Alignments in the DD sequence (“asap”, “alap” or “center”).
Defaults to the alignments of STANDARD_DD_STRATEGY . These three parameters are parallel lists defining the default DD strategy, and must have
the same length. Setting any of them to an empty list means there is no default DD strategy. Alignments in the DD sequence (“asap”, “alap” or “center”).
Defaults to the alignments of STANDARD_DD_STRATEGY . These three parameters are parallel lists defining the default DD strategy, and must have
the same length. Setting any of them to an empty list means there is no default DD strategy. title: iqm.cpc.core.observation.observation_loading_rules.resolve_rules
description:
Resolves the rules related to loading and fall back one by one. If an observation is loaded successfully from the DB, the rule resolving is terminated.
Returns the loaded observation and the rule that...
content:
Resolves the rules related to loading and fall back one by one. If an observation is loaded successfully from the DB, the rule resolving is terminated.
Returns the loaded observation and the rule that ended up producing it. If global observation loading rules has been set with set_global_default_observation_loading_rules() ,
then those rules will override anything given in rules .
Global observation rules can be set to an empty list, in that case no rules will be used,
i.e. observation will not be loaded at all.
If global observations rules are set to None, then those will be ignored
and original rules given as a parameter will be used. observation_name ( str ) – the name of the observation to search for in the database. rules ( Sequence [ RuleType ] ) – the list of rules to be resolved in loading the observation. dut_label ( str ) – the label of the DUT for which this observation will be loaded. default_storage ( StorageInterface | None ) – the default storage to be used for loading observations if the rule does not have its own
storage backend. rule_cache ( RuleCache | None ) – cache of preloaded observations for certain load rules. Loading from the rule cache takes
precedence over the normal rule execution. The observation that was loaded (None if no rule successfully fetched an observation). The name of the rule class that produced the above observation
(None if no rule successfully fetched an observation). The observation that was loaded (None if no rule successfully fetched an observation). The name of the rule class that produced the above observation
(None if no rule successfully fetched an observation). content:
Full path: iqm.cpc.core.observation.observation_load_utils Utilities for loading observations from StorageInterface . Contains the storage queries used by the observation loading rules, as well as the cache loading functions
that RuleCache maps the cacheable loading rules to. All functions here are self-contained: they take the StorageInterface instance they operate on as an argument
and have no dependency on any ambient runtime.
